headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 28, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins fell short in Toronto, dropping a 1-2 decision to the Blue Jays. Kazuma Okamoto led the Marlins' offense with a home run and an RBI. The Washington Nationals also fell short in Cleveland, losing 2-3 to the Guardians. CJ Abrams led the Nationals' offense with 2 hits and 1 RBI.

Several players have been impacted by injuries and availability. Garrett Whitlock has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Boston Red Sox due to left knee inflammation. The Detroit Tigers have also placed Kenley Jansen on the 15-day injured list due to pelvic inflammation. In addition, the Toronto Blue Jays have transferred Lazaro Estrada to the 60-day injured list due to right shoulder impingement and placed Lenyn Sosa on the 10-day injured list retroactive to May 27, 2026, due to a right wrist contusion.

The Detroit Tigers have bolstered their pitching staff with the acquisition of left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold. The Colorado Rockies have traded left-handed pitcher Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash, while the Philadelphia Phillies have traded right-handed pitcher Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for future considerations and international bonus pool money. The Cincinnati Reds have traded right-handed pitcher Zach McCambley to the Miami Marlins for right fielder Rece Hinds.

top_news.title: **Marlins Fall Short in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dropped a 1-2 decision to the Toronto Blue Jays, unable to overcome a strong performance from the home team. Kazuma Okamoto led the Marlins' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall Short in Cleveland**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dropped a 2-3 decision to the Cleveland Guardians in their latest matchup. CJ Abrams led the Nationals' offense with 2 hits and 1 RBI, while Gavin Williams earned the win for the Guardians with 7 strong innings.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Brewers in 2-1 Decision**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers edged the St. Louis Cardinals 2-1, securing a narrow victory. Dustin May led the Brewers' pitching effort with 7.0 innings pitched, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Mariners Cruise Past Athletics 9-1**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners dominated the Oakland Athletics, securing a 9-1 victory. Logan Gilbert led the way on the mound, pitching 6.0 innings with 6 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Red Sox RHP Garrett Whitlock Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Boston Red Sox right-handed pitcher Garrett Whitlock has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to left knee inflammation, effective retroactive to May 25, 2026.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire LHP Juanmi Vasquez in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold.
